scope: One graph-level theorem: an unordered pair has at most one common-neighbor owner under the explicit no-four-cycle hypothesis and four-vertex distinctness premises. Six conditional integer-count theorems prove the packing threshold, matching/excess budget and one-side optimal-support rigidity. Three kernel-decided finite Pappus certificates check simple cubic bipartiteness, no repeated common-neighbor pair and a ten-vertex dissociation set. Finite cardinal pair summation, representative reduction, projective-plane instantiation and full parameter equalities retain written proofs; they are not claimed fully formalized.
